# late-game

A long retail Emerald playthrough, post-game (all 8 badges, Champion beaten),
saved on Route 117; save counter 1658. Party: Salamence L50, Magcargo L38,
Smeargle L100. 411 Pokémon in the PC, a full bag (58 TM/HM entries, 20 key
items). 131072 bytes (flash only, no RTC footer: made in another emulator).

Used by the save-compatibility tests: lots of flags, vars, boxes and items to
compare between retail and the hack.
